movie.title: Never After Dark
movie.overview: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A traveling psychic investigating a haunted remote home encounters a malevolent entity and uncovers a terrifying, unexpected threat.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A gifted traveling psychic who guides lost souls into the afterlife is called to investigate a remote, eerie residence. Upon arrival, she encounters a surprisingly powerful entity with mysterious ties to the property's shadowed past. As she unravels the dark secrets surrounding its origins, she realizes the danger is far greater than anticipated. Ultimately, she must confront a deadly threat emerging from a source she never saw coming.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: A lone psychic travels from place to place, dedicating her life to helping restless spirits cross over into the afterlife. Her routine work takes a terrifying turn when she is summoned to an isolated home shrouded in unsettling history. Upon entering the house, she immediately senses an oppressive force far stronger than any entity she has previously encountered. Driven by her commitment to the dead, she begins probing into the history of the residence and the mysterious circumstances of the spirit's origin. Her investigation unearths deeply buried secrets involving betrayal, hidden traumas, and tragic events forgotten by time. However, as the entity's aggression escalates, the psychic realizes that the supernatural presence is not her only concern. The true nature of the threat shifts, revealing a mortal or unexpected origin that poses a fatal danger to her survival. Trapped in the remote location, she must use all her spiritual insight and quick wits to escape the perilous environment. She is forced to confront a shocking betrayal that turns her mission of mercy into a desperate fight for her own life.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: In 'Never After Dark', a skilled traveling psychic who spends her life assisting lost souls in finding peace takes on a challenging case at an isolated, mysterious house. What begins as a routine effort to help a restless spirit transitions into a chilling investigation when she realizes the entity possesses unprecedented power. As she digs into the tragic history and dark secrets embedded within the remote estate, she begins to untangle a complex web of deceit. However, the spiritual danger pales in comparison to an unforeseen, deadly threat lurking nearby. Combining elements of psychological drama and spine-tingling horror, this story follows her high-stakes struggle to uncover the truth before the darkness consumes her.

story_structure.climax: She faces a life-or-death confrontation with this sudden threat in a desperate struggle to break the house's hold and survive the night.
story_structure.conflict: Instead of a typical spirit, she encounters a malevolent and unusually powerful entity tethered to the house's sinister past.
story_structure.resolution: With the hidden threat confronted, the spirits are granted peace, and she departs back onto the road, changed by the ordeal.
story_structure.introduction: A traveling psychic arrives at a remote, isolated house on a routine assignment to assist lost souls in crossing over.
story_structure.risingAction: As she investigates the entity's origins, hidden dark secrets come to light, revealing that the true danger stems from an unexpected source rather than the entity itself.
